title: Add real text embeddings acceptance profile

context.summary: Make the local demo path able to prove upload -> chunk -> embedding -> pgvector index -> semantic search with a fake-compatible local model service.
context.background: Integration tests already cover OpenAI-compatible embeddings with a fake provider. The local Docker demo still needs a self-contained strict indexed profile so users can run acceptance without external model credentials.

in: Add a lightweight local model HTTP service for the local-models Compose profile.
Support /health, /embeddings and /chat/completions in the local service.
Configure pnpm mvp:demo --model-profile local to enable local-http text embeddings with 1536 dimensions.
Make strict indexed live acceptance work with the local model profile.
Validate that docs and demo scripts describe the local strict indexed path.
out: Downloading or running heavy local model weights.
Changing the default disabled model profile.
Implementing OCR, ASR, vision, face or generation adapters.

acceptance_criteria: The local-models Compose profile runs a local HTTP model service instead of a health-only placeholder.
The local service returns deterministic 1536-dimensional embeddings.
mvp-demo local model profile sets local-http text embedding env defaults.
Strict indexed acceptance can be selected with --model-profile local --require-indexed.
Integration tests still cover fake OpenAI-compatible embedding indexing and semantic search.
Docs describe the self-contained local strict indexed acceptance command.

manual_checks: Confirm the default mvp demo profile remains disabled.

risks: The local profile must remain lightweight and deterministic.
The demo helper must not override user-provided external embedding env values.
The local fake-compatible service must not be documented as production model serving.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
